name: language
label: Language
description: Specifies the scripting language for the editor.

name: isClientScript
label: Script type
description: Enables you to choose between Server or Client as script type.

name: scope
label: Scope
description: Specifies application scope of the script.

name: content
label: Content
description: Specifies the content seen on editor load that can be edited later.

name: readOnly
label: Disable editing
description: Enables you to edit the editor content.

name: disableWordWrap
label: Disable word wrap
description: Enables you to wrap the editor content.

name: disableSyntaxHighlighting
label: Disable syntax highlighting
description: Enables you to render the editor in plain text mode.

name: disableFullScreen
label: Disable full screen
description: Enables you to view the editor content in full screen.

name: hideToolbar
label: Hide toolbar
description: Toggles visibility of the toolbar.

name: hideGutter
label: Hide gutter
description: Toggles visibility of the gutter.

name: disableMinimap
label: Hide minimap
description: Toggles visibility of the minimap functionality.

name: disableDebugging
label: Disable debugging
description: Enables you to debug the script of the editor.

name: recordType
label: Record type
description: Specifies the name of the table to which the script belongs to. For example, 'sys_script_include'.

name: scriptField
label: Script field
description: Specifies the script field of the table to which the script belongs to.

name: sysId
label: Sys id
description: Specifies the sys ID of the record.

name: autocompleteSuggestions
label: Autocomplete suggestions
description: Set "disabled" to false to add ServiceNow suggestions to the default script suggestions. Set "variant" to 'append' to add custom suggestions to the default script suggestions. Set "variant" to 'replace' to replace default script suggestions with custom suggestions. Set "suggestions" to an array of custom intellisense strings of TypeScript definition.

name: editorMode
label: Editor mode
description: Specifies the mode for the editor. "Default" editor view enables you to focus on one script block. "Diff" editor view enables you to compare two script blocks side by side

name: originalContent
label: Original content
description: Specifies the uneditable original content with which "Content" will be compared.

name: disableToggleDiffView
label: Disable switching between modes
description: Enables you to switch between "Default" and "Diff" editor mode.

name: customIcons
label: Custom gutter icons
description: Specifies custom icons for the gutter of the JSON editor.
